response.sql: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS cnt FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), city_avg AS (SELECT City, AVG(cnt) AS city_avg FROM rep_counts GROUP BY City), above AS (SELECT r.EmployeeId, r.City, r.cnt, (r.cnt - a.city_avg) AS excess FROM rep_counts r JOIN city_avg a ON r.City IS a.City WHERE r.cnt > a.city_avg), overall AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM Customer WHERE SupportRepId IN (SELECT EmployeeId FROM Employee)) SELECT ab.City AS city, SUM(ab.cnt) AS total_customers, AVG(ab.excess) AS avg_excess_above_city_avg, AVG(ab.cnt * 1.0 / o.total) AS avg_share_of_overall_total FROM above ab CROSS JOIN overall o GROUP BY ab.City;
